title: 11 Best AI People Analytics Software for Indian Enterprises in 2026
summary: Compare the 11 best AI people analytics software for Indian enterprises in 2026 and find the right platform for smarter workforce decisions.
body_markdown:
AI people analytics software can change HR decision-making, yet only 18% of CHROs say their organizations use data analytics to make smarter people decisions consistently.


Indian enterprises find this gap gets pricey, especially when


[employee attrition](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-engagement/guide-to-employee-attrition)


averaged 17.4% in 2024. Workforce analytics platforms offer predictive models that can anticipate resignations months in advance, among other automated HR reporting capabilities. We've assessed the leading enterprise people analytics solutions to help you choose the right fit for your organization.


## [inFeedo AI: Best for Real-Time Employee Listening and AI-Driven Sentiment Analysis](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


### What inFeedo AI is Best For


Annual engagement surveys have a fundamental problem: they capture sentiment after damage occurs. inFeedo AI addresses this through its Amber bot, which operates as an AI-powered Chief Engagement Officer. Amber reaches employees from onboarding through exit with milestone-specific conversations rather than scheduled survey windows.


Over 330+ CHROs globally trust Amber, which makes it suited for Indian enterprises managing multilingual workforces across distributed locations.


The platform handles cultural nuances specific to Indian companies through


[multilingual sentiment detection](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/what-indian-enterprises-really-need-in-ai-employee-experience-platforms-for-2026)


in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and 30+ other languages.


Amber verifies DPDP Act compliance while processing feedback in regional languages, unlike generic survey tools. This prevents misinterpretation when employees express concerns in their native tongue. Organizations where workforce diversity extends beyond metro cities into regional operations need this capability.


### Key AI People Analytics Features


Amber draws from 9 years of People Science research and 80M employee responses.


The platform applies a framework with 7 drivers and 45 elements that workplace psychologists verified across 3 peer-reviewed publications.


Amber achieves a 90% response rate on surveys, much higher than traditional engagement tools that don't deal very well with reaching 40%.


The proprietary


[PTM (People-To-Meet) algorithm](https://www.infeedo.ai/predictive-people-analytics)


identifies employees at risk of leaving.


The algorithm analyzes sentiment patterns, behavioral moves and silence.


Silent employees present a specific challenge since they're 3x more likely to quit than those who participate. Amber flags these individuals early and groups them by risk levels.


Managers can then intervene 60 to 90 days before resignation becomes inevitable.


Genpact deployed Amber across 130,000 employees with measurable retention effect.


Employees who participate with Amber are 2x more likely to stay at the organization.


This makes it the only non-financial metric driving bonus pools for 200+ leaders at Genpact.


Organizations using Amber improved engagement scores by 24.8% in one quarter.


The platform offers 26 psychologist-designed templates


for pulse surveys covering manager effectiveness and annual engagement.


Amber uses GPT-3 via OpenAI to categorize sentiment during chat sessions. The AI builds context through questions and answers to improve accuracy. Amber auto-summarizes conversations and creates manager-specific action plans.


The platform generates board-ready reports, which eliminates manual analysis of millions of responses.


### Pricing and Implementation


Pricing is quote based. Amber blends with Slack, Microsoft Teams, HRIS platforms and ATS systems through SSO and API connectors.


The platform maintains compliance with GDPR, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. This meets enterprise-grade security requirements for organizations in 60+ countries.


### Pros and Cons


**Strengths** : The 90% survey response rate


surpasses industry standards.


The 2x retention improvement at Genpact


demonstrates measurable ROI.


Multilingual support for Indian languages with DPDP compliance


addresses regulatory and cultural requirements at the same time.


Amber automates 98% of routine HR queries, which frees managers for strategic work.


**Limitations** : The platform requires consistent employee participation to build the data that powers predictive accuracy over time. Organizations without feedback cultures may need time to achieve optimal response rates.


**Bottom Line** : inFeedo AI delivers workforce analytics software designed for Indian enterprise needs. The platform combines predictive attrition modeling with cultural and regulatory intelligence that generic platforms lack.


## [Darwinbox: Best for Large Indian Enterprises with Integrated HCM Suite](https://darwinbox.com/)


Image Source:


[Darwinbox](https://darwinbox.com/)


### What Darwinbox is Best For


Darwinbox operates as an AI-native HCM platform built for large-scale Indian enterprises managing 1,000+ employees across multiple locations.


The platform serves 900+ international businesses with


[3 million+ users](https://explore.darwinbox.com/org/ph/hr-software-pricing)


and stands as the only Customer's Choice platform in Asia Pacific for large enterprises. Organizations that choose Darwinbox need deep talent management integration with workforce analytics rather than standalone people analytics tools.


The platform received a 4.7/5 rating on Gartner Peer Insights


and 4.4/5 on G2. 96% of customers recommend the experience to their peers. Major Indian enterprises use Darwinbox when they need a unified system managing everything from recruitment through retirement. Analytics embed across the employee lifecycle rather than being bolted on afterward.


### Key AI People Analytics Features


Darwinbox Cortex powers the next generation of


[AI-driven people analytics](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/how-ai-powered-hr-metrics-drive-better-people-decisions-in-2025)


and delivers individual-specific insights for quick actions across the organization.


The platform has Darwinbox Atlas, an all-in-one reporting and analytics engine designed for fast-growing organizations.


Darwinbox Sense operates as an AI-powered workforce intelligence ecosystem. It integrates intelligent chatbots into recruitment and engagement processes across WhatsApp, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.


PROSE (People's Relational and Organizational Semantic Engine) functions as an HR-centric AI model that detects hiring bias, personalizes interview questions, and analyzes diversity metrics.


The AI-driven Workforce Analytics suite makes organizations forecast talent risks and identify engagement trends.


It also implements strategic retention programs.


The Workforce Diversity Dashboard monitors DEI progress live and eliminates unconscious bias. Enterprises that require both integrated HCM and employee listening can pair Darwinbox with inFeedo AI. This creates an analytics stack covering transactional HR data and continuous sentiment intelligence.


### Pricing and Implementation


Darwinbox pricing operates on a per-employee-per-month subscription bundled by module.


Contracts sell on one, two, or three-year terms.


Bands in 2026 sit between


[₹200 and ₹600 PEPM](https://hrone.cloud/blog/darwinbox-pricing/)


depending on bundle depth.


PEPM lands around ₹450 at the 200-employee tier and drops to ₹180 at 10,000+ headcount. Core HR plus Payroll forms the floor.


Talent, LMS, Engagement, and Darwin AI modules raise PEPM 40 to 80 percent.


Implementation takes months rather than weeks.


This timeline works for very large enterprises with multi-country complexity but proves excessive for organizations under 1,000 employees needing faster deployment.


### Pros and Cons


The platform delivers


[enterprise-grade HCM](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/8-factors-to-evaluate-in-ai-employee-experience-tools)


with strong talent management and multi-country support.


Modular architecture allows customization as business needs evolve.


The consumer-grade user-friendly design drives high employee adoption rates.


But modules beyond Core HR can feel complex for new users.


The reporting feature requires time to master custom report creation.


Analytics dashboards need improvement according to enterprise users.


The platform remains nowhere near affordable or simple enough for SMEs


and requires dedicated HR IT teams for optimal operation.


## [ZingHR: Best for Multi-Location Workforce Intelligence with Power BI Integration](https://www.zinghr.com/)


Image Source:


[www.zinghr.com](https://www.zinghr.com/)


### What ZingHR is Best For


ZingHR serves enterprises managing 1,000+ employees in Manufacturing, BFSI, Retail & QSR, Pharma, Logistics, and Healthcare where


[multi-location workforce](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/hr-reporting-standardization-multi-unit-businesses)


complexity just needs integrated analytics.


The platform operates as a strategic command center for Boards and CXOs. It combines workforce management with native business intelligence rather than requiring separate analytics tools.


ZingHR has 1,200+ customers and 2.4M+ active users globally.


The platform addresses organizations running operations in multiple Indian states or international geographies in SEA and EMEA.


The platform's strength lies in unifying operational workforce data with board-ready analytics.


Organizations managing contract labor, multi-shift operations, or distributed field teams find ZingHR especially effective. Attendance, compliance, and payroll data feed directly into the same Power BI dashboards leadership reviews.


### Key AI People Analytics Features


ZingHR embeds Power BI natively within the platform and delivers 19 dashboards that load live data from all 22 modules.


The Zing Intelligence Hub has ZingIntel dashboards covering Headcount, Attrition, Payroll, Performance, Recruitment, and Succession with drill-down from organizational to individual level.


CHROs access workforce intelligence without switching systems or waiting for manual reports.


Ghrowth.ai functions as the AI layer.


It consolidates signals from HR, Finance, Sales, and Operations into role-specific views for CEOs, CFOs, CHROs, and Boards.


The platform surfaces compliance risks,


[attrition patterns](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/attrition-forecasting-employee-disengagement-signs) , and workforce gaps before they escalate. This changes leadership focus from historical reporting to forward-looking risk detection.


Multi-location workforce dashboards break down headcount, attrition, overtime, and compliance metrics by location, state, department, and employee type.


Geo-fenced GPS mobile attendance captures coordinates with every entry.


Face recognition operates at 95% accuracy


and eliminates proxy attendance at factory gates and retail counters.


Zero-touch attendance-to-payroll integration removes manual reconciliation. Analytics draw from validated source data.


Pairing ZingHR with inFeedo AI creates detailed coverage for enterprises requiring both operational workforce analytics and continuous sentiment intelligence. This combination spans transactional HR data and employee listening.


### Pricing and Implementation


Pricing operates on a quote-based model, scaled to headcount and module selection.


Implementation timelines extend for complex, multi-entity setups. ZingHR suits organizations prioritizing depth over speed.


### Pros and Cons


The platform eliminates data silos in hire-to-rehire processes


while providing board-level analytics through embedded Power BI.


Strong compliance features serve regulated industries well.


Users report slow loading and lagging interfaces, though.


Some note the application feels laggy during daily use.


Advanced customization requires specialist support.


The platform delivers more capability than teams under 100 employees need right away.


## [PeopleStrong: Best for Predictive Workforce Analytics and What-If Simulations](https://www.peoplestrong.com/hr-analytics-software/)


Image Source:


[PeopleStrong](https://www.peoplestrong.com/)


### What PeopleStrong is Best For


PeopleStrong targets the 1,000 to 5,000-employee band where hierarchy-heavy, multi-entity organizations need


[predictive workforce analytics](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/predictive-hr-analytics-benefits)


rather than reactive reporting.


The platform serves 500+ enterprises and 2 million+ employees in APAC, addressing BFSI, large retail, manufacturing with blue-collar workforces, and GCCs running pan-India units. Organizations choose PeopleStrong at the time they require what-if scenario modeling to test workforce decisions before execution. This makes it distinct from platforms focused on historical trend analysis.


The honest buyer profile has CHROs managing complex organizational structures across multiple entities with compliance-intensive operations. The platform's breadth means implementation velocity matters less than predictive modeling depth to these buyers.


### Key AI People Analytics Features


PeopleStrong's AI-powered analytics engine delivers hindsight, insight, and foresight by tracing trends and patterns in workforce data. The predictive analytics module uses


[10 different statistical models](https://www.peoplestrong.com/blog/predictive-analytics-the-next-big-thing-in-recruitment/)


in the background and analyzes data sets for seasonality and variability.


It identifies and ignores noise through line smoothening techniques. This model auto-predicts patterns for the next 9-12 months.


It self-learns by auto-correcting itself as organizations feed more data.


The what-if simulator allows HR teams to test decisions before implementation.


Advanced predictive models eliminate biases.


Interactive storyboards simplify large data sets by presenting insights through visual narratives that drive useful decision-making.


Smart dashboards provide live updates with customizable charts built from over 75 measures and 178 filters.


Organizations can create customizable reports divided by department, geographic location, experience level, and performance level. Enterprises requiring both predictive workforce modeling and continuous employee sentiment intelligence can pair PeopleStrong with inFeedo AI. This creates detailed coverage across scenario planning and live listening.


### Pricing and Implementation


Indicative PEPM ranges sit between


[₹120 and ₹280 for standard modules](https://hrone.cloud/blog/peoplestrong-review-india/) , with implementation fees ranging from ₹8 lakh to ₹45 lakh. Average go-live takes 2.5 months.


Complex full-suite deployments extend to 3-5 months. The subscription clock starts on day one of purchase.


A six-month implementation slip at 1,000 employees costs ₹14.5 lakh in subscription paid before a single payslip runs.


### Pros and Cons


PeopleStrong scores 68 out of 100 on the enterprise HCM framework.


This reflects strong module breadth and APAC footprint.


The platform maintains GDPR compliance and secure data management.


But implementation risk, TCO transparency, and UX velocity remain weak points. Configuration depth often needs vendor intervention.


Mobile-to-desktop UX shows unevenness, and some users report the interface looks outdated.

[Keka HR](https://www.keka.com/)

[workforce analytics](https://www.infeedo.ai/people-analytics-guide) .


Keka built its PeopleOS in 2014 from Hyderabad for organizations seeking self-serve HR without IT dependency.


The platform serves both India and the US natively and handles TDS, PF, ESIC, PT, and LWF compliance for Indian teams while supporting full US payroll in all 50 states.


### Key AI People Analytics Features


Keka's AI layer reads signals continuously and flags attrition risk, payroll anomalies, and goal drift while recommending actions to take.


The platform identifies early attrition signs by analyzing performance data through 360-degree feedback, one-on-one reviews, continuous feedback, and goal tracking.


Pulse surveys capture


[employee sentiment](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-experience/leverage-sentiment-analysis-data-to-boost-employee-engagement-and-satisfaction)


around happiness, growth, work-life balance, and manager relationships.


Workforce dashboards provide headcount reports, attrition analysis, and trend tracking through a custom report builder.


The analytics engine gets into attrition by tenure, compensation, performance, departments, locations, and exit reasons.

### Pricing and Implementation

Additional employees cost ₹60-150 per head depending on the plan.


A setup fee equal to 2x monthly subscription applies and covers guided payroll configuration and data migration.


Implementation runs 45-90 days, with subscription billing starting on purchase day rather than go-live.


Organizations requiring both workforce analytics and continuous employee sentiment intelligence can pair Keka with inFeedo AI to create detailed coverage of transactional HR data and live listening.


### Pricing and Implementation


The platform delivers modern, employee-friendly UX that drives higher adoption than legacy Indian HR software.


India-compliant payroll handles salary revisions and statutory requirements with depth.


But implementation timelines of 60-90 days can create subscription costs before value delivery.


Some users report learning curves and complexity for smaller teams initially.

## [Visier: Best for Deep Dedicated People Analytics and Predictive Modeling](https://www.visier.com/)


Image Source:


[Visier](https://www.visier.com/)

Organizations that need dedicated workforce analytics software rather than HCM platforms with analytics add-ons find Visier eliminates the compromise between talent management breadth and analytical depth. The platform functions as a pure-play people analytics solution and integrates data from existing HR systems without forcing enterprises to replace their HRIS, ATS, or payroll infrastructure. Visier serves mid-to-large organizations that prioritize predictive modeling accuracy over transactional HR functionality.


Research shows only


[17% of organizations worldwide](https://www.visier.com/blog/predictive-hr-analytics/)


use HR data to optimize processes. This creates massive competitive advantages for enterprises that deploy advanced people analytics.


Visier addresses this gap through machine learning models proven 17 times more accurate than guesswork at predicting exit risk and movement.


### Key AI People Analytics Features


Visier's predictive engine uses random forest machine learning technique and explores historical employee data and events like promotions, resignations, and internal hires to construct decision trees. The platform identifies employees most likely to resign, receive promotions, or move internally.


Predictions recalculate constantly as new data flows in.


Validation metrics measure how closely predicted exits, promotions, and internal moves match actual outcomes\[312\]. This increases stakeholder trust through confirmed accuracy.


The platform requires 24 months of historical data for predictions and 36 months for accurate validation.


Vee, Visier's AI assistant, delivers instant workforce insights through natural language queries in Teams, Office, and Copilot.


Organizations achieve measurable results: First West Credit Union reduced turnover costs by ₹42.19 crore.


The platform provides built-in replacement cost multipliers that estimate departure expenses by job level: 0.5x for entry roles, 1.25x for mid-level, and 2.5x for executives.


Enterprises that require both predictive workforce modeling and continuous


[employee sentiment intelligence](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/nlp-employee-sentiment-analysis-guide)


can pair Visier with inFeedo AI. This creates detailed coverage across transactional analytics and live listening.


### Pricing and Implementation


Visier operates on custom quote-based pricing scaled to employee count, users, and features.


The platform demonstrates 293% average five-year ROI with payback in about 7.5 months.


Implementation complexity varies based on data onboarding requirements and security configuration.


### Pros and Cons


The platform delivers reliable


[data visualization capabilities](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/7-things-to-know-about-automated-hr-reporting)


with practical insights and strong data unification.


Customization options remain limited, though\[342\].


Users note complexity in backend configuration


and learning curves for company-specific metrics\[342\].
